'''Arn Peralun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender|male]] [[cyborg]] Jedi Knight who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Third Galactic War|third war]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] after [[3627 BBY]] as [[Tau Idair]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].

==Biography==
While on the planet [[Dakot Seven]] with his master, Arn was wounded severely by artillery fire when he attempted to [[Battle on Dakot Seven|defend]] the native population from [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. While Arn survived, [[Arn Peralun's master|his master]] did not. Unfortunately, the people native to Dakot Seven were biologically incompatible with [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] and [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]], and took to healing Arn in the only way they knew how: cybernetics. Upwards of eighty percent of Arn's body was replaced and augmented to keep him alive.<ref name="TOR-TUC">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Arn Peralun}}</ref>

[[File:Tau_Idair_draws_lightsaber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Arn's Master Tau Idair]]
His recovery took years, setting him back in his training as a Padawan, making him one of the oldest padawans of the order. Master [[Gnost-Dural]] took an interest in the Padawan, however, and assigned him to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] to continue his training.

Peralun was sent alongside the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] by Gnost-Dural where he was to meet his new master. When they arrived, Peralun was introduced to the Sith [[Lana Beniko]], before the pair were able to meet with Idair. After meeting his new master, a nearby explosion promoted the three to investigate further. Peralun was able to correctly identify [[Darth Savik]]'s presence on Onderon, enabling the Republic to coordinate with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Deja Nebet]] to thwart the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] plans for the planet.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Following their success on Onderon in routing the Sith's forces and successfully apprehending Savik, Peralun accompanied his master to [[Mek-Sha]]. The Republic was able to successfully pursue their objectives there while removing the Sith's influence from the colony.

[[File:Arn_Peralun_on_Dantooine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Arn Peralun on Dantooine]]
However, Peralun's previous encounters with slavers on Dakot Seven led him to hunt down the slaver group known as [[the Brothers]]. Peralun gave into his anger and slew the slavers without his master being aware of what had transpired. Idair and Gnost-Dural both later said that Peralun was remorseful for his actions, but both also conceded that Peralun had given in to his anger and prejudice.<ref name="Brothers">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Brothers Keeper|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

It was following Peralun's setback on Mek-Sha that he accompanied the Republic to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to protect the [[Meridian Complex]], and there, alongside his master, faced off against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. In the aftermath of the battle, Malgus was defeated (but survived the encounter), while the complex was saved. However, both master and pupil were almost killed in the encounter, and were later treated for their injuries. The pair were both saved by the Jedi Knight [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], both of whom were in search for the Commander's assistance.<ref name="Onslaught" />

===Joining Task Force Nova===
Peralun later joined [[Task Force Nova]], a joint military-civilian initiative partnered with the Alliance to reunite Jedi scattered throughout the galaxy to settle a new homeworld. While traveling with General Daeruun's fleet to [[Odessen]], they were forced to answer a distress call from a refugee ship under attack by [[Dire Skulls]]. After managing to chase off the pirates, Peralun and Idair went in pursuit.<ref name="Onslaught" /> By this time, Idair and Gnost-Dural believed Peralun to be almost ready for his Jedi Knight [[Jedi Trials/Legends|trials]], a prospect he found both terrifying and exciting.<ref name="Hope">{{TORcite|type=message|Hope you're doing well|Arn Peralun}}</ref>

[[File:Arn_Peralun_and_Tau_Idair_on_Elom.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Arn Peralun and Tau Idair help restrain Darth Malgus on Elom.]]
Peralun would later accompany the Commander and [[Aryn Leneer]] when they traveled to the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of Darth Malgus. When they reported their findings to Gnost-Dural, [[Sal-Deron]], Tau Idair, and [[Vinyor Tesh]], Peralun stood up for Leneer when Tesh asked that she be expelled from the meeting on the basis that she was no longer a member of the Jedi Order and thus was not privy to the affairs of the Jedi.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref> Peralun would go on to work with Tesh to uncover that the artifact stolen from Dantooine by Malgus was once owned by [[Darth Nul]], but what properties the artifact had and what Maglus intended to do with it was still a mystery to them.<ref name="TORWEB">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Arn.png|thumb|right|200px|Arn Peralun concept artwork]]
Arn first appears in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Twitter" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
During the Republic storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'', players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]] have the opportunity to flirt with Arn at a couple of points, once after rescuing him from his wrecked ship, and once after defeating Major [[Cadmael Benthos Dosk|Dosk]], stating that they "enjoy his company".<ref name="LOTS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> Later, Arn will send the player a message via in-game mail reciprocating their feelings, stating that he enjoys their company as well, and likes it when they refer to him as "Arn Peralun, Jedi Knight".<ref name="Romance Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Very glad you did|Arn Peralun}}</ref>

Arn and the player can flirt when they reunite on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] to explore [[Darth Nul's Laboratory]], and again before the player departs to meet with [[Darth Jadus]] on the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]. After the player is betrayed and left for dead on the ''Enigma'', Arn will arrive just in time to save them, and he and the player can share their first kiss, after which he will apologize for how long it took to happen.<ref name="Masters Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|[[Odessen]] and the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]}}</ref>
